name: hauzral-pharmacy-pos
description: Hauzral Pharmacy POS - Complete Pharmacy Management System

scripts.install:all: npm run install:client && npm run install:server
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npx vite build
scripts.db:create: cd server && npx wrangler d1 create pharmacy-pos-db
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx wrangler d1 execute pharmacy-pos-db --file=./scripts/seed.sql

author: Hauzral
